title: Change of counit normalization for conjugated Hom maps
statement: Assume the shared module-sheaf derived-category instances for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category], and write $L_p=Lp^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Use the old counit-pinned composition system [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition, lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport] and the explicit original-counit composition system [lem-pc-recorded-pullback-composition, lem-pc-recorded-perfect-hom-transport]. There is a family of natural automorphisms $e_p:L_p\cong L_p$, indexed by every scheme arrow $p$, with the following property. For every $s:X\to S$, every arrow $g:T'\to T$ of schemes over $S$, every $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, and every $a:L_{p_T}P\to L_{p_T}Q$, where $p_T:X\times_ST\to X$ and $p_{T'}:X\times_ST'\to X$ are projections, the recorded conjugated Hom map equals $e_{p_{T'}}(P)$ followed by the old Hom map applied to $e_{p_T}(P)^{-1}$ followed by $a$ followed by $e_{p_T}(Q)$, followed by $e_{p_{T'}}(Q)^{-1}$. No perfectness, geometric finiteness, directedness or colimit hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use leftDerivedUnique to identify the two counits on each fixed derived pullback. Its factorization equation pins the natural automorphism e_p. Rewrite the two composition counits with these equations; naturality of e_f at the old counit of g and functoriality identify their composites. Apply leftDerived_ext to obtain the composition-comparison change-of-counit equation.

proof.text: Apply the comparison equation and its inverse to the conjugated Hom maps. Naturality of the base-change automorphism cancels its two components. The remaining projection automorphisms give the stated formula. Equality induction transports it through baseChangeMap_fst.
